content.thinking:
I'm noticing a conflict in the terms: the order says EXW Boise, yet also says the seller prepays freight, insurance and duties and adds them to the invoice. That mixes up who arranges shipping, so I'll flag it as a red flag. The total price isn't stated, so I won't calculate one. I'm now checking the quantity on the order confirmation, which shows 9,000 units.

I'm pulling the key figures from the order confirmation now: the confirmed quantity, the confirmation date of November 14, 2025, the original order date of October 9, 2025, and a unit price of 6.11 USD.

statements.text_en: Terms of delivery: EXW Boise, ID per Sales Agreement PC-0011-2023, section 4.1. DDP is not agreed. Freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice.

verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25710946 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318563 (dated 2025-10-09). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 9,000 units at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2025-11-14. Terms are EXW Boise with NET30 payment. The document has no handwriting, corrections or stamps.
red_flags: The delivery terms contradict each other. They say EXW Boise and that DDP is not agreed. They also say freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays for freight, so the buyer should check whether these charges will be invoiced.
The document shows no total value and no document date. Only the PO date (2025-10-09) and the confirmed delivery date (2025-11-14) are given.
observations: No handwriting, stamps, strike-throughs or signatures.
The description wraps over three lines in the table: 'Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5'.
